all the people, who had become dross, are to be gathered together in it
and the fire of the Chaldeans, blown by the wrath of God, is to melt the whole. No ordinary means will avail to purge their impurities
the most violent must therefore be resorted to. Eze 11:7

refs: The prophets employed all their ingenuity to varnish over the crimes of the princes - the antecedent to them to palliate their offences, and to conceal their faults, while they were like ravening wolves, and took bribes to shed innocent blood. By these means they shared the dishonest gains with the princes, or availed themselves of their authority to gratify their avarice or revenge. Eze 22:25
